title: Dashboard Elements & Privacy Controls
description: Major dashboard enhancements introducing rich text blocks, file attachments, and comprehensive privacy controls with a powerful markdown editor.
highlights: Rich text blocks with markdown editor and formatting toolbar
File attachment support with upload/download functionality
Dashboard privacy toggle with collaborator management

items.title: Text Block Elements
items.description: Add rich text content to dashboards with a powerful markdown editor featuring a formatting toolbar inspired by Excel's text controls.
details: Rich text toolbar with font size selector (12px-36px)
Text formatting: Bold, Italic, Underline, Strikethrough
Heading styles: H1, H2, H3 for document structure
List support: Bullet lists and numbered lists
Insert links and code blocks with markdown syntax
Live markdown preview shows formatted output in real-time
Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+B (bold), Ctrl+I (italic), Ctrl+U (underline)
Smart cursor positioning preserves selection when formatting
Markdown syntax insertion at cursor position
Text elements persist across page refreshes

items.title: File Attachment Elements
items.description: Upload and attach files directly to dashboards with drag-and-drop support and secure storage.
details: Drag-and-drop file upload interface
200MB file size limit per attachment
File metadata display: name, size, type
Secure file storage in SurrealDB as base64
One-click file download from dashboard
File validation and error handling
Upload progress indication
Files persist with dashboard across sessions

items.title: Dashboard Privacy Controls
items.description: Owner-only privacy toggle to control dashboard visibility with automatic collaborator management.
details: Privacy toggle in three-dot menu (owner-only access)
Visual indicators: Lock icon (private), Globe icon (public)
Confirmation dialog with detailed warnings
Making private: removes all collaborators and share tokens
Making public: enables link-based sharing
Clear warning about revoking access when making private
Instant privacy state updates across UI
Backend enforcement of owner-only privacy changes

items.title: Element Editor System
items.description: Type-aware element editing with specialized interfaces for text, files, and visualizations.
details: ElementEditorWrapper detects element type automatically
Text editor: Full rich text toolbar with live preview
File editor: Title editing and file information display
Chart editor: Existing advanced customization interface
Edit elements via context menu or double-click
Changes save immediately to dashboard
Consistent editing experience across element types

items.title: Dashboard Element Persistence
items.description: Fixed critical issues with element persistence and loading from the database.
details: Fixed SurrealDB UUID handling with type::thing() for proper RecordId comparison
Elements now correctly load from database on page refresh
Fixed element existence check to prevent duplicate creation
Proper angle bracket stripping from UUIDs (⟨uuid⟩ → uuid)
Backend queries use direct ID interpolation for RecordId fields
Element fetch query fixed to properly match dashboard RecordId
Comprehensive logging for debugging element operations

items.title: Element Rendering Logic
items.description: Improved element type detection and rendering to prevent errors with new element types.
details: ChartRenderer now excludes text and file types from rendering
Proper v-if/v-else-if chain for element type routing
Text elements render with markdown processor
File elements show download interface
Fixed 'undefined is not valid JSON' error for text elements
Element dimensions now respect type-specific defaults (text: 6x4, file: 4x3)

items.title: Dashboard Store Reactivity
items.description: Enhanced Vue reactivity for dashboard state updates to ensure UI consistency.
details: Create new object reference when updating dashboard data
Ensures deep reactivity propagation in Vue
Element additions immediately reflect in UI
Layout changes trigger proper re-renders
Fixed element dimension handling in store (uses element.w/h instead of hardcoded values)

items.title: Backend File Storage
items.description: Implemented secure file upload and download endpoints with SurrealDB storage.
details: POST /dashboards/:dashboardId/files for file uploads
GET /files/:fileId for file downloads
Multipart form data parsing with Hono
Base64 encoding for database storage
File metadata tracking: name, size, type, upload date
Proper Content-Type and Content-Disposition headers for downloads
200MB file size validation on backend

items.title: Privacy Management Endpoint
items.description: New backend endpoint for dashboard privacy updates with collaborator cleanup.
details: PUT /dashboards/:id/privacy endpoint
Owner-only authorization check
Deletes all dashboard_permission entries when making private
Removes share_token when making private
Atomic privacy state updates
Comprehensive error handling and logging

items.title: Database Query Fixes
items.description: Critical fixes to SurrealDB queries for proper RecordId handling.
details: All CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE queries use type::thing() for IDs
Parameterized queries for UUID values
Fixed user RecordId comparison in WHERE clauses
Element fetch uses direct dashboard ID interpolation
Proper RecordId extraction from query results
